{{Top|leg}}
'''White Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]] assigned to [[Operation Cobolt]]. White Team was assigned to secure and retrieve the operation's target, the [[Scandoc decoding computer]].
